lines.text: The LORD tells the Daughter of Babylon to sit in the dust and grind flour with millstones.
The Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel, and Babylon will no longer be called the queen of kingdoms.
The LORD was angry with His people and placed them under Babylon's control, and she showed them no mercy.
Babylon says she will never be a servant or lose children, but both losses will come in a single day.
Babylon's astrologers are like gold that the fire burns up, and they cannot save her.
